notes.title: The exciting moment has arrived!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45396457/89143648daa345e0c2b5a80f13c4ebf669bbf36e.png[/img]
**Game Update Announcement**

Dear Players,

🎉🎉🎉 The exciting moment has arrived! We are thrilled to announce that our indie game will soon receive an update! This update will bring you an even richer gaming experience, making your adventure journey more colorful and fascinating!

🌟 **Highlights of New Content**:

1. **More Towers**:
   - To meet your ever-growing strategic demands, we have carefully designed several brand-new towers. These towers not only possess unique attack methods and powerful firepower but can also form more diverse tactical combinations with existing towers. Whether it's single-target burst damage or area-of-effect control, there's always one that suits your tactical layout!

2. **More Mechs**:
   - Mech lovers, rejoice! In this update, we have introduced multiple awesome mechs for you to choose from. These mechs not only look cool but also possess formidable combat abilities and unique skills. Piloting these mechs, you will be unstoppable on the battlefield, becoming a true invincible warrior!

3. **More Combinations**:
   - With the addition of new towers and mechs, the combination strategies in the game have become even more diverse. You can freely mix and match towers and mechs according to your preferences and tactical needs, creating unique battle combinations. Whether you pursue extreme firepower or adaptability, you can find your battle style here!

- During the update process, if you encounter any issues or have suggestions, please feel free to contact me, and I will do my best to assist you and provide solutions.

Thank you for your continued support and love! We look forward to exploring this even more vibrant and colorful game world with you! Let's join hands and embark on a brand-new adventure journey!

notes.title: v1.0.1 more features
notes.content:
[h3] During the Spring Festival, I wish you all a happy Chinese New Year[/h3]
V1.0.1 is here
First of all, I've added the enemy hit effect, which is a small feature to make the shooting more hitty
Then, I added more weapons, as well as turrets
You can even drive a battleship in a weapon case
Our spider pet also has more features
You can command the spiders to move and stop, they won't follow you all the time, you can place them, and you have more strategies
But the main thing is that it's cool
Thank you for playing my game

[h3]春节期间，祝各位春节快乐[/h3]
V1.0.1来了
首先，我添加了敌人的受击效果，这是一个小功能，让射击更有打击感
然后，我添加了更多的武器，以及炮塔
甚至你可以在武器箱里开出战舰
我们的蜘蛛宠物也有了更多的功能
可以指挥小蜘蛛们移动和停止了，它们就不会一直跟着你，可以进行放置，有了更多的策略
但是主要还是爽就完事了
在此感谢你们游玩我的游戏
